title: A Barrier-Regularized Symmetric Nitsche Method for the Signorini Problem
summary: We introduce and analyze a barrier-regularized symmetric Nitsche method for the scalar Signorini problem. Applying a logarithmic barrier to the nonnegative slack variable in an augmented Lagrangian and then eliminating that variable yields a smooth positive-part operator and the perturbed complementarity relation on a primal-dual central path, with barrier parameter $μ=γs$. For every $s>0$, the discrete problem is continuously differentiable, uniquely solvable, and has a symmetric positive definite Newton matrix when the Nitsche parameter is sufficiently large.
